name: Dad Coach Weekly Plan
description: Authoritative state of the father's current Sunday-Saturday quality-time week, computed by Dad Coach in the father's timezone: local now, week boundaries, weekly goal, coverage in minutes (completed + valid planned vs target), sessions with lifecycle phase, today's and next session, sessions awaiting confirmation, previous-week result, progress and links.
guidance: Source of truth for the father's current Sunday-Saturday week, computed by Dad Coach in the father's timezone - never recompute. father_found=false: no Dad Coach profile yet. timezone; now = local_date, local_time, weekday. current_week = week_start, week_end, days_left_including_today. goal = this week's goal (exists, status, target_hours, target_minutes, credited_minutes). coverage = target_minutes, completed_minutes (credited), planned_minutes (still-valid scheduled sessions of this week that have not ended), covered_minutes, uncovered_minutes (gap still to plan), is_covered, awaiting_confirmation_minutes (not counted). Sessions are one line each: 'PHASE | child | N min | WEEKDAY date HH:mm-HH:mm | starts in N min / ended N min ago | id=<quality_time_id>' with PHASE UPCOMING, IN_PROGRESS, AWAITING_CONFIRMATION (ended, not confirmed), COMPLETED, CANCELLED or MISSED; collections are keyed by local 'date time' and say 'none' when empty: sessions_this_week, sessions_today (still-valid, later today), next_session, awaiting_confirmation, scheduled_after_this_week. previous_week = week_start, week_end, goal_exists, goal_status, goal_target_minutes, goal_credited_minutes, goal_met, completed_minutes, completed_sessions, not_completed_sessions; previous_week_completion_notes. goal_history = has_any_goal, weeks_with_goal, latest_previous_target_hours. progress = belt and streaks. calendar_connected; dashboard_url.
